title: Define canonical ntfy alert classes
goal: Define and verify five canonical, secret-safe ntfy event classes with deterministic class-specific rendering, priorities, tags and correlation headers while preserving Grabowski outbox truth and fail-closed acknowledgement semantics.

approval.note: The user ordered implementation of the next tasks. Repairing and completing the existing PR is allowed; producer wiring, secret exposure, foreign-work override and unproven user_seen claims remain excluded.

acceptance.assertion: Exactly five canonical ntfy event classes are declared and each has deterministic class-specific title/body rendering, priority, tags and correlation headers.
Rendered payloads remain bounded and redact or reject secret-bearing and unsupported fields; no task truth, credentials or private evidence bytes are leaked.
Outbox acknowledgement occurs only after confirmed HTTP 2xx delivery; transport failure, malformed configuration or unsupported classes preserve pending truth and produce structured evidence.
Focused and full relevant tests, exact diff-bound review and required GitHub CI pass on one exact PR revision bound only to this task.
The closeout states explicitly that dispatcher-format parity does not establish producer bindings, owner-device reception, user_seen truth or universal end-to-end delivery.

rollback.strategy: Revert the exact Grabowski PR and redeploy the immediately previous commit-bound dispatcher. Preserve outbox truth, receipts and pending notifications; do not acknowledge or discard messages during rollback.

does_not_establish: authority to modify foreign active work
